resources.string: Encrypted copies include all financial records and payments. To restore on another device, keep both the file and its recovery phrase.
Conflicting changes were found. Nothing was silently overwritten. Export both devices as files before resolving the conflicting records, then retry.
Connection failed. Check the HTTPS WebDAV URL, app password, recovery phrase and network.
Nextcloud returned HTTP %1$d. Check credentials, permissions and server availability.
Connect your personal Nextcloud using the WebDAV URL from Files settings and a separate app password. Only encrypted data is uploaded.
Sync runs when you press the button. Encrypted history files are retained in WispFinance; no background sync is enabled.
Leave blank to keep the saved cloud key, or use this device’s key for a new connection. If connecting to an existing copy, enter its phrase. Keep that phrase: it decrypts Nextcloud files.
The operation could not be completed. Check the file, free space and access permissions.
24 English hyphenated word pairs, separated by spaces. Keep their order. Wisp Finance format, not a wallet seed. This phrase always stays in English when you change the app language.
Old files are not encrypted. Importing them cannot protect copies that were previously shared.
The phrase is invalid or does not match. Check all 24 word pairs and their order.

Restoring replaces current records. An encrypted pre-restore copy is saved first. Future exports keep using the phrase currently shown in Settings, even if this file uses a different phrase. Old copies keep their original phrase.
I saved the phrase separately from the backup file.
End-to-end encryption protects exported files and Nextcloud data. The working database on this phone remains in Android’s protected app storage; it is not encrypted with this phrase.
Keep this phrase offline and private. Anyone with it and the file can read your data. Without the phrase, the encrypted file cannot be recovered. Existing records stay on this device.
Incorrect phrase or damaged encrypted file. No data was restored.
Choose which values to use for conflicting records. Other changes are merged. Encrypted copies of both versions are kept on the server. Cancel to inspect or export your data first.
